name: Reciprocity
overview: Scripture teaches that reciprocity is a principle grounded in mutual responsibility and gratitude within the body of Christ. Believers who have received spiritual blessings are called to share materially with those who minister to them, as seen in Paul’s exhortations that those who benefit spiritually ought to provide for others' physical needs. This mutual sharing honors the relationship between teacher and taught and reflects the debt of care and support believers owe one another.
